name: WA-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 10 points on the partisan baseline
Incumbent Emily Randall holds a massive fundraising edge ($1.2M vs $28K)
Prediction markets price Democratic win at 98%
No outside spending against Randall and no expert raters flag the race
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Randall: a 10-point Democratic lean, first-term incumbency, a dominant money advantage, and no outside opposition, with markets pricing her near-certain. With no polls available, uncertainty stays wide, but nothing in the evidence suggests a competitive race.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a single-digit race or unexpected outside spending against Randall would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Emily Randall, a first-term Democratic incumbent, seeks re-election in a district that leans Democratic by about 10 points. She has raised roughly $1.2 million and holds over $240,000 in cash, while Republican Teresa Fox has raised under $30,000 with minimal cash on hand. No outside groups are spending against Randall, and prediction markets give her about a 98% chance of winning.

No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, the fundraising gap, and market pricing. The seat is rated Safe Democratic, though the absence of polling keeps uncertainty somewhat elevated.
